overview: FSHQ.gg Integration Functions Specification defines comprehensive external system integration patterns, focusing primarily on Sleeper API synchronization. The architecture implements adaptive polling with differential sync, automated moment generation from external events, stat correction detection and re-grading workflows, and comprehensive error handling with circuit breakers. All integrations use service-layer abstraction, implement caching strategies (24h for static data, 1h for rosters, 5min for live matchups), and include rate limiting to stay within API constraints (1000 req/min for Sleeper). The system supports multi-league coordination, transaction deduplication, and real-time season state awareness for intelligent sync frequency adjustments.

fetchSleeperLeague.purpose: Retrieve league configuration and settings from Sleeper API
business_rules: Cache league settings for 24 hours as they rarely change mid-season
Track version timestamp to detect league setting changes

fetchSleeperRosters.purpose: Retrieve all team rosters and owner mappings for a league
business_rules: Cache roster data for 1 hour during season
Map Sleeper roster_id to FSHQ team_id using external_reference

fetchSleeperMatchups.purpose: Retrieve weekly matchup schedule and scores for specific week
business_rules: Poll every 5 minutes during active game days
Use change detection (checksum) to avoid reprocessing unchanged data

fetchSleeperTransactions.purpose: Retrieve league transactions including trades, waivers, and free agent moves
business_rules: Differentiate between trade, waiver, and free_agent transaction types
Handle multi-team trades correctly

fetchSleeperPlayers.purpose: Retrieve comprehensive NFL player database for roster display
business_rules: Cache player data for 24 hours (updates daily max)
Update player database weekly during season for status changes

fetchSleeperNFLState.purpose: Retrieve current NFL season state to determine active week and season phase
business_rules: Poll NFL state hourly to detect season phase changes
Use season_type (pre, regular, post) to adjust sync frequency

detectStatCorrections.purpose: Identify when matchup scores change due to NFL stat corrections after initial results
business_rules: Monitor completed matchups for 72 hours after week conclusion
Detect score changes greater than 0.1 points as corrections

performDifferentialSync.purpose: Sync only changed data since last successful sync using checksums
business_rules: Track last sync timestamp per league and data type
Compare checksums (MD5 hash) of fetched vs stored data

generateAutomatedMoment.purpose: Create feed moment from detected external event (trade, match result, transaction)
business_rules: Auto-generate grammatically correct text with league-specific terms
Tag moments for filtering and searchability

triggerReGrading.purpose: Recalculate pick'ems and predictions when stat corrections change match outcomes
business_rules: Recalculate winners based on corrected scores
Update leaderboards and user statistics atomically

syncLeagueComplete.purpose: Orchestrate complete league sync including rosters, matchups, transactions, and moment generation
business_rules: Execute in priority order: NFL state, league settings, current week matchups, rosters, transactions
Queue sync requests to prevent concurrent syncs for same league

InitialLeagueSync.trigger: User connects a new Sleeper league to FSHQ
steps: Validate Sleeper league_id and check accessibility
Fetch and store league configuration and settings
Fetch and map all team rosters to FSHQ teams
Fetch NFL player database for player name resolution
Fetch complete transaction history
Fetch all weekly matchups for current season
Mark league as connected and schedule ongoing sync jobs
InitialLeagueSync.rollback: If sync fails midway, mark league as connection_failed and allow retry

WeeklyMatchupSync.trigger: Scheduled sync job during active NFL week (5min during games, 1hr off-games)
steps: Fetch current NFL season state to determine active week
Fetch matchup data for active week from Sleeper API
Perform differential sync - compare checksums with stored matchups
Update only changed matchup scores in database
Generate match result moments if week finalized
Update team records (wins/losses) and standings
WeeklyMatchupSync.rollback: No rollback needed - differential sync is additive

StatCorrectionDetectionAndRegrade.trigger: Scheduled monitoring job runs on completed weeks (every 4 hours for 72 hours post-week)
steps: Fetch matchup data for completed weeks within correction window
Compare current scores against stored scores using checksum
Detect score changes greater than 0.1 points as stat corrections
Identify all affected pick'ems entries and commissioner predictions
Recalculate winners/losers based on corrected scores
Update pick'ems leaderboards atomically
Generate corrected match result moment with explanation
Send notifications to users whose entries were affected
StatCorrectionDetectionAndRegrade.rollback: If re-grading fails, preserve original grades and allow manual re-grade

TransactionSyncAndMomentGeneration.trigger: Scheduled transaction sync (hourly during season, daily off-season)
steps: Fetch transactions for recent rounds from Sleeper API
Perform differential sync - identify new transactions
Check if moment already exists (deduplication)
Generate automated moment based on transaction type
Publish moment to league newsfeed with timestamp
TransactionSyncAndMomentGeneration.rollback: No rollback - moment deduplication prevents duplicates

Transactions.target: FSHQ transactions table and newsfeed moments

StatCorrections.frequency: every 4 hours for 72 hours post-week completion
